primitives.name: Confidence Score Calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Confidence is a score, not a probability.** Measured 2026-09-13: the 80+ band claimed 0.8663 and realized 0.5191 (z = -10.7).

primitives.breakdown_regime: When z-score exceeds threshold, calibration is invalidated.

primitives.name: Typecheck Verification Integrity
primitives.verbatim_quote: **A check is not trusted until it can demonstrate it fails.** The typechecker silently passed for an hour while it was actually being killed by the host.
primitives.assumptions: Typecheck integrity requires active failure demonstration to be considered valid.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Silent pass indicates host-level interference or resource exhaustion.
